select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      s_tech_tvma6,
                                      s_tech_tvma20,
                                      s_tech_tvma60,
                                      s_tech_tvstd6,
                                      s_tech_tvstd20,
                                      s_tech_vema5,
                                      s_tech_vema10,
                                      s_tech_vema12,
                                      s_tech_vema26,
                                      s_tech_vroc6,
                                      s_tech_vroc12,
                                      s_tech_vr,
                                      s_tech_turnoverrate5,
                                      s_tech_turnoverrate10,
                                      s_tech_turnoverrate20,
                                      s_tech_turnoverrate60,
                                      s_tech_turnoverrate120,
                                      s_tech_turnoverrate240,
                                      s_tech_turnoverratevol20,
                                      s_tech_mktfaciind,
                                      s_tech_cyf,
                                      s_tech_volumevolatility,
                                      s_tech_volume1m60,
                                      s_tech_volumn1m,
                                      s_tech_turn5dturn120,
                                      s_tech_turn10dturn120,
                                      s_tech_turn20dturn120,
                                      s_tech_amount1m60,
                                      s_tech_cry,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_turnovertechnicalfactor.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.turnovertechnicalfactor WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
